wuz:
The hollyhocks air jest ez pink, they 're double ones at that,
An' I wuz prouder of 'em than a baby of a cat.
But now I don't go near 'em, though they nod an' blush at me,
An' I wuz so frighten I tu'n roun' ready fo' hollow fo' blue murder, but de Lord was wit' me an' He protect me.
“How wuz I to know he’d be a great caterer, feedin’ bank presidents and everything?
"Yo' heah all dah ruction las' night, Maria, like dey wuz bringing up a dead man up de stairs?"
"Shucks, he wuz so bent 'pon wha' he wuz gwine do he couldn't hav' eyes fo' nobody but me!
We wuz gwine blow up de dam, cut down de wireless station, an' breck up de gubment house!
wuzn't: Heah I wuz losin' my foot fo' dem wit' dere bleddy canal an' dey come tellin' me dey wuzn't to blame, dat nobody wuz to blame, dat de engine wuz gwine slow an' dat I wuz musta been layin' down on de job.
"Chile, if it wuzn't fo' dis umbrella I wouldn't know where I'd be by now.
wuzzahmo: And wuzzahmo' dey say dat why I didn't ketch holt o' de cow-katcher an' fling meself outa de way!
